# Architecture Overview

HuskySat-2 follows the F' App-Manager-Driver separation. Each software layer has a distinct responsibility and communicates through typed component ports.

| Level | Responsibility |
|-------|----------------|
| Level 1 | Passive Linux-backed drivers expose buses and operating-system resources without device knowledge. |
| Level 2 | Hardware managers own device protocols, initialization, recovery, and device-specific telemetry. |
| Level 3 | Applications implement subsystem behavior and coordinate managers, framework services, and mission work. |
| Level 4 | `SatStateMachine` will coordinate satellite modes by sending typed commands to Level 3 applications. |

The five top-level document sections are shown below. The first establishes context for the four runtime software layers that follow.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
    I["Introduction and System Context"] --> L1["Level 1 - Drivers"]
    L1 --> L2["Level 2 - Hardware Managers"]
    L2 --> L3["Level 3 - Application Layer"]
    L3 --> L4["Level 4 - SatStateMachine Layer"]
```

`CdhCore` supplies shared command, event, health, version, and fatal-handling services around the application topology. Framework services used by the Level 3 layer are described individually in that section rather than reproduced as a separate repository summary.
